hook: A 12-year-old, top-15 Sacramento salon (4.7-4.8 stars, 400+ reviews) whose own domain is dead and which runs only on a Vagaro booking page and Instagram — no real website despite a strong local reputation.

images.note: Photographs on the site are illustrative salon photography, not the salon's own work — the site says so in the gallery note and points guests to @Alchemysalonandspa for the salon's own photos.
images.source: Unsplash (free-licensed). Every photo was downloaded and VIEWED for actual subject vs trade before use. No image ID is reused from design-log.json (checked programmatically).
